set(LLVM_TARGET_DEFINITIONS Passes.td)
mlir_tablegen(Passes.h.inc -gen-pass-decls -name ODEToACR)
add_public_tablegen_target(ChemCompODEToACRPassIncGen)
add_mlir_doc(Passes ODEToACRPasses ./ -gen-pass-doc)

# The rule table is a plain data table, generated by chemcomp-tblgen (see
# ../CRNToDB/CMakeLists.txt for why the command is spelled out).
set(_rules_inc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ODERules.inc)
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT ${_rules_inc}
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:chemcomp-tblgen> -gen-ode-rules
          -I ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ODERules.td
          -o ${_rules_inc}
  DEPENDS chemcomp-tblgen ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ODERules.td
  COMMENT "Building ODERules.inc..."
)
add_custom_target(ChemCompODERulesIncGen DEPENDS ${_rules_inc})
set_target_properties(ChemCompODERulesIncGen PROPERTIES FOLDER "Tablegenning")
